description: The queries the client library runs on an iModel before the first question: the startup query list. It sends their rows with every turn.

ecsql: any ECSql. {{in:list}} expands a list from `lists` to 'a', 'b'. {{like:expr:list}} expands to (expr LIKE '%a%' OR ...), and {{notlike:expr:list}} to (expr NOT LIKE '%a%' AND ...); a value that already contains % is used as written.
max: rows sent (default 20); the rest are counted, up to 500. A query that fails sends no rows and its error.

onlyIfEmpty: run only when the named queries of the same rule were empty (no rows, or a single 0). each: a second query run for every row sent, with the row's columns as {0}, {1}; its first value is sent with the row. Every `each` query runs to the end: there is no time limit, because the first context matters more than the seconds it takes.
Keep everything generic: no names or values from one iModel.

queries.ecsql: SELECT ConnectorName, COUNT(*) AS sources FROM bis.ExternalSource WHERE ConnectorName IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ConnectorName ORDER BY sources DESC
SELECT Name FROM meta.ECSchemaDef WHERE {{like:Name:connectorSchemaPatterns}} ORDER BY Name

SELECT s.Name, b.Name, SUM(n.cnt) AS n FROM (SELECT ECClassId AS cid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bis.Element GROUP BY ECClassId) n JOIN meta.ClassHasAllBaseClasses h ON h.SourceECInstanceId = n.cid JOIN meta.ECClassDef b ON b.ECInstanceId = h.TargetECInstanceId JOIN meta.ECSchemaDef s ON s.ECInstanceId = b.Schema.Id WHERE s.Name IN ({{in:standardDomainSchemas}}) GROUP BY b.ECInstanceId ORDER BY s.Name, CASE WHEN b.Modifier = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, n DESC

SELECT s.Name, b.Name, SUM(n.cnt) AS n FROM (SELECT ECClassId AS cid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bis.ElementAspect GROUP BY ECClassId) n JOIN meta.ClassHasAllBaseClasses h ON h.SourceECInstanceId = n.cid JOIN meta.ECClassDef b ON b.ECInstanceId = h.TargetECInstanceId JOIN meta.ECSchemaDef s ON s.ECInstanceId = b.Schema.Id WHERE s.Name IN ({{in:standardDomainSchemas}}) GROUP BY b.ECInstanceId ORDER BY s.Name, CASE WHEN b.Modifier = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, n DESC

SELECT s.Name, b.Name, SUM(n.cnt) AS n FROM (SELECT ECClassId AS cid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bis.ElementRefersToElements GROUP BY ECClassId) n JOIN meta.ClassHasAllBaseClasses h ON h.SourceECInstanceId = n.cid JOIN meta.ECClassDef b ON b.ECInstanceId = h.TargetECInstanceId JOIN meta.ECSchemaDef s ON s.ECInstanceId = b.Schema.Id WHERE s.Name IN ({{in:standardDomainSchemas}}) GROUP BY b.ECInstanceId ORDER BY s.Name, CASE WHEN b.Modifier = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, n DESC

SELECT ec_classname(base.ECInstanceId) AS base, COUNT(*) AS classes, SUM(n.cnt) AS elements, MAX(c.Name) AS example FROM (SELECT ECClassId AS cid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bis.Element GROUP BY ECClassId) n JOIN meta.ECClassDef c ON c.ECInstanceId = n.cid JOIN meta.ECSchemaDef cs ON cs.ECInstanceId = c.Schema.Id JOIN meta.ECClassDef base ON base.ECInstanceId = (SELECT b.ECInstanceId FROM meta.ClassHasAllBaseClasses h JOIN meta.ECClassDef b ON b.ECInstanceId = h.TargetECInstanceId JOIN meta.ECSchemaDef s ON s.ECInstanceId = b.Schema.Id WHERE h.SourceECInstanceId = n.cid AND s.Name IN ({{in:standardDomainSchemas}}) ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meta.ClassHasAllBaseClasses d WHERE d.SourceECInstanceId = b.ECInstanceId) DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE cs.Name NOT IN ({{in:standardDomainSchemas}}) AND cs.Name NOT IN ('BisCore', 'Generic') AND n.cid NOT IN (SELECT SourceECInstanceId FROM meta.ClassHasAllBaseClasses WHERE TargetECInstanceId = ec_classid('BisCore', 'DefinitionElement')) GROUP BY base.ECInstanceId ORDER BY base.ECInstanceId

SELECT COALESCE(s.UserLabel, s.CodeValue) AS systemName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ECInstanceId) AS tables, COUNT(c.ECInstanceId) AS classifications FROM ClassificationSystems.ClassificationSystem s LEFT JOIN ClassificationSystems.ClassificationTable t ON t.Parent.Id = s.ECInstanceId LEFT JOIN ClassificationSystems.Classification c ON c.Model.Id = t.ECInstanceId GROUP BY s.ECInstanceId

SELECT b.Name AS kind, p.Name, COUNT(*) AS classes, MIN(ec_classname(c.ECInstanceId)) AS exampleClass FROM meta.ECPropertyDef p JOIN meta.ECClassDef c ON c.ECInstanceId = p.Class.Id JOIN meta.ClassHasAllBaseClasses h ON h.SourceECInstanceId = c.ECInstanceId JOIN meta.ECClassDef b ON b.ECInstanceId = h.TargetECInstanceId JOIN meta.ECSchemaDef s ON s.ECInstanceId = b.Schema.Id WHERE s.Name = 'BisCore' AND b.Name IN ('GeometricElement3d', 'GeometricElement2d', 'DefinitionElement', 'ElementUniqueAspect', 'ElementMultiAspect') AND {{like:p.Name:classificationWords}} AND {{notlike:p.Name:notClassificationWords}} GROUP BY b.Name, p.Name ORDER BY classes DESC, p.Name
queries.each: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bis.[{0}] x WHERE x.$->[{1}] <> ''
